<FI> As for<Fi> his father<WH01>, because he cruelly<WH06233> oppressed<WH06231><WTH8804>, spoiled<WH01497><WTH8804> his brother<WH0251> by violence<WH01499>, and did<WH06213><WTH8804> <FI>that<Fi> which <FI>is<Fi> not good<WH02896> among<WH08432> his people<WH05971>, lo, even he shall die<WH04191><WTH8801> in his iniquity<WH05771>.
